ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( ISCHANGED( Status__c ), OR ( TEXT(Status__c) = "TC - Voluntary Request To Cancel/Terminate", TEXT(Status__c) = "TD - Deceased", TEXT(Status__c) = "ZC - Voluntarily Surrender Or Forfeit License Due To Disciplinary Action", TEXT(Status__c) = "ZD - Forfeited Disciplined License; Needs To Restore", TEXT(Status__c) = "ZF - Terminated Due To Recovery Fund Payout", TEXT(Status__c) = "ZO - Out Of State Disciplinary Action", TEXT(Status__c) = "ZP - Voluntary Suspension", TEXT(Status__c) = "ZR - Revoked", TEXT(Status__c) = "ZS - Suspended", TEXT(Status__c) = "ZV - Voluntary Revocation", TEXT(Status__c) = "ZZ - Prohibited From Practice Pending Hearing", TEXT(Status__c) = "ZW - Conditional License Withdrawn" ), ISNULL( CancelDate__c ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This status can only be set by clicking the "Update/Cancel License" button. Please click that button to update the License Status
